result.summary: Identified 2 UI issues involving category filtering consistency and image assets.

issues.description: 'Pizza' filter is selected, but non-pizza items appear under 'Fastest near you'.
issues.suggestion: Update filter logic to ensure displayed lists reflect the active category.

issues.description: Generic vector illustrations are shown in place of restaurant food photography.
issues.suggestion: Replace vector placeholders with high-quality photos of real menu items.
